name: Passport Copy (All Shareholders & Managers)
how_to_obtain: Personal passport copy, valid for at least 6 months.

name: Emirates ID / UAE Visa Copy
how_to_obtain: Emirates ID and visa page for UAE residents.
notes: Non-residents may provide the entry stamp instead.

name: Memorandum of Association (MOA)
how_to_obtain: Notarized agreement setting out the partners and the capital structure.
notes: Not required for a single-owner LLC.

name: Ejari Tenancy Contract
how_to_obtain: Physical office lease registered in the Ejari system.
notes: A physical office is mandatory for mainland companies.

name: No Objection Certificate (NOC)
how_to_obtain: Required if you currently work in the UAE under another sponsor.
notes: For employees holding a sponsored visa.

name: Trade Name Reservation Certificate
how_to_obtain: Apply on the DET portal with 3 alternative trade names.
notes: Issued after the trade name is approved.

name: Qualification Proof / CV
how_to_obtain: Degree or equivalency certificate for regulated professions.
notes: May be requested for professional license applications.

name: Passport Copy
how_to_obtain: Personal passport copy, valid for at least 6 months.

name: Proof of Address (Utility Bill)
how_to_obtain: Electricity, water or credit card statement from the last 3 months.

name: Passport-Size Photograph
how_to_obtain: Two passport photos with a white background.
notes: A digital version is also accepted.

name: Application Form with UBO Declaration
how_to_obtain: Downloaded from the zone portal; completed with ultimate beneficial owner details.
notes: Shareholders holding 25% or more must be declared.

name: Business Plan (Brief)
how_to_obtain: Short English document describing the business model.
notes: Mandatory for regulated activities in some zones such as DMCC.

name: No Objection Certificate (NOC)
how_to_obtain: Required if your UAE visa is held under another sponsor.

name: Financial Statement (Simplified)
how_to_obtain: IFZA: simplified form if turnover is at most AED 3M and there are at most 9 employees.
notes: Mandatory for IFZA license renewals from 30 September 2025.

name: Audited Financial Statement
how_to_obtain: IFZA: full audit if turnover exceeds AED 3M or there are more than 9 employees.
notes: IFRS-compliant, signed by a UAE-registered auditor.
